breakdown.description: Mass/volume conservation is violated for steady incompressible flow in constant area (Q cannot change from inlet to outlet).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that the outlet flow rate of 0.02 m³/s violates mass/volume conservation for steady incompressible flow in a constant-area pipe. It enforced Q_out = Q_in = 0.01 m³/s using the continuity equation, matching the ground truth's requirement that volumetric flow rate must be constant.
